definition: The sound of people clapping their hands.
examples: The singer got loud applause.
The applause lasted for five minutes.
Let's have some applause for our teacher.

spanish.definition: Sonido de personas dando palmas.

definition: A word for a king or queen; great beauty and power.
examples: Good morning, Your Majesty.
We looked at the majesty of the mountains.
His Majesty will speak tonight.

spanish.definition: Palabra para un rey o una reina; gran belleza y poder.

definition: A soft and beautiful way of moving; a short prayer before a meal.
examples: She dances with grace.
My grandfather always says grace before dinner.
He accepted the bad news with grace.

spanish.definition: Forma suave y bonita de moverse; oración corta antes de comer.

definition: A polite word for a man.
examples: Hey, mister, you dropped your wallet.
Excuse me, mister, is this seat free?
Listen to me, mister, you're in trouble.

spanish.definition: Palabra educada para un hombre.

definition: An informal way to say no.
examples: Are you hungry? Nope.
Nope, I haven't seen your keys.
Did he call? Nope, not yet.

spanish.definition: Forma informal de decir no.

definition: A word you say when you are surprised.
examples: Oh my gosh, look at the time!
Gosh, you've grown so much!
Gosh, I didn't know that.

spanish.definition: Palabra que dices cuando estás sorprendido.

definition: A very loud, deep sound; a fast increase in business.
examples: We heard a loud boom outside.
The city had a building boom.
Boom! The balloon broke.

spanish.definition: Sonido muy fuerte y profundo; aumento rápido de un negocio.

definition: A word for a prince or princess.
examples: Yes, Your Highness.
Her Highness arrived at noon.
His Royal Highness visited the school.

spanish.definition: Palabra para un príncipe o una princesa.

definition: A word you shout when someone did something very well.
examples: Bravo! That was a great show.
The crowd shouted bravo at the end.
Bravo, you finished the race!

spanish.definition: Palabra que gritas cuando alguien hizo algo muy bien.

definition: A soft word you say when you are angry or surprised.
examples: What the heck is that?
Oh, heck, I forgot my phone.
Why the heck did you do that?

spanish.definition: Palabra suave que dices cuando estás enojado o sorprendido.

definition: Money you pay so a person can leave jail until the trial.
examples: His brother paid his bail.
The judge set bail at ten thousand dollars.
She's out on bail.

spanish.definition: Dinero que pagas para que una persona salga de la cárcel hasta el juicio.

definition: Soft earth used for making pots and bricks.
examples: The kids made animals out of clay.
This old pot is made of clay.
The clay gets hard in the oven.

spanish.definition: Tierra suave que se usa para hacer ollas y ladrillos.

definition: The number 50.
examples: My father is fifty.
There are fifty states in the U.S.
It costs fifty dollars.

spanish.definition: El número 50.

definition: The number 30.
examples: She's almost thirty.
I'll be there in thirty minutes.
We invited thirty people.

spanish.definition: El número 30.

definition: The number 12.
examples: A year has twelve months.
We have lunch at twelve.
My son is twelve years old.

spanish.definition: El número 12.

definition: All the people in the world; kindness to others.
examples: This disease is a danger to humanity.
He treated the prisoners with humanity.
The internet changed humanity.

spanish.definition: Todas las personas del mundo; bondad con los demás.

definition: Not able to do something.
examples: I was unable to sleep last night.
She's unable to walk after the accident.
We were unable to find the hotel.

spanish.definition: Que no puede hacer algo.

definition: A big, dangerous fish with sharp teeth.
examples: A shark swam near the boat.
Most sharks don't attack people.
He's afraid of sharks.

spanish.definition: Pez grande y peligroso con dientes afilados.

definition: A strong building that soldiers use for protection.
examples: The soldiers stayed inside the fort.
We visited an old fort by the sea.
The kids built a fort with blankets.

spanish.definition: Edificio sólido que usan los soldados para protegerse.

definition: Coming from God; very good.
examples: She believes in divine help.
This chocolate cake is divine.
They prayed for divine love.

spanish.definition: Que viene de Dios; muy bueno.

definition: A reason why you don't agree with something.
examples: I have no objection to your plan.
Objection, Your Honor!
My parents had a serious objection to the trip.

spanish.definition: Razón por la que no estás de acuerdo con algo.

definition: A tall machine that lifts heavy things; a tall bird with long legs.
examples: A crane lifted the steel into the air.
There are three cranes at the building site.
We saw a white crane by the lake.

spanish.definition: Máquina alta que levanta cosas pesadas; ave alta de patas largas.

definition: A small seed that you cook and eat.
examples: I'd like rice and beans.
Green beans are good for you.
These coffee beans come from Colombia.

spanish.definition: Semilla pequeña que se cocina y se come.

definition: The act of going in; a door or a place to go in; a piece of writing in a list.
examples: The sign says no entry.
Leave your shoes by the entry.
I wrote a new entry in my diary.

spanish.definition: Acción de entrar; puerta o lugar para entrar; texto en una lista.

definition: Harm to your body.
examples: He has a knee injury.
She got a head injury in the crash.
The player can't play because of an injury.

spanish.definition: Daño en el cuerpo.

definition: A heavy load; something that is hard to deal with.
examples: I don't want to be a burden to my kids.
The debt is a big burden for the family.
The horse carried a heavy burden.

spanish.definition: Peso grande; algo difícil de manejar.

definition: To get on a horse or a bike; to fix something to a wall.
examples: He mounted his horse and rode away.
We mounted the TV on the wall.
She mounted her bike and left.

spanish.definition: Subirse a un caballo o una bicicleta; fijar algo en una pared.

definition: A small object that gives power to a phone or a toy.
examples: My phone battery is dead.
This toy needs two new batteries.
The car battery stopped working.

spanish.definition: Objeto pequeño que da energía a un teléfono o un juguete.

definition: Sweet food you eat at the end of a meal.
examples: What's for dessert?
We had apple pie for dessert.
I'm full, but I want dessert.

spanish.definition: Comida dulce que se come al final.

definition: A cheap hotel near a road for people traveling by car.
examples: We stopped at a motel for the night.
The motel was next to the highway.
I found a cheap motel in Texas.

spanish.definition: Hotel barato cerca de una carretera para quienes viajan en carro.

definition: Liking someone or something very much.
examples: I'm very fond of my aunt.
He's fond of old movies.
I have fond memories of that house.

spanish.definition: Que quiere o le gusta mucho alguien o algo.

definition: In the middle between two places or times.
examples: We stopped halfway to Chicago.
I fell asleep halfway through the movie.
We're at the halfway point.

spanish.definition: En el medio entre dos lugares o momentos.

definition: A long gun.
examples: The soldier carried a rifle.
He cleaned his rifle after hunting.
She knows how to use a rifle.

spanish.definition: Arma de fuego larga.

definition: The desk where you arrive in a hotel or office; a party after a wedding; the quality of a phone signal.
examples: Please leave your key at reception.
The wedding reception was at a hotel.
I have bad reception here.

spanish.definition: Mostrador de llegada en un hotel u oficina; fiesta después de una boda; calidad de la señal.

definition: A figure of a person or animal made of stone or metal.
examples: There's a statue in the park.
We visited the Statue of Liberty.
The statue is two hundred years old.

spanish.definition: Figura de una persona o animal hecha de piedra o metal.

definition: A machine that keeps food cold.
examples: Put the milk in the fridge.
There's nothing in the fridge.
She took a beer out of the fridge.

spanish.definition: Máquina que mantiene fría la comida.

definition: A hard block used for building walls.
examples: The house is made of brick.
He put the bricks in a neat line.
They live in an old brick building.

spanish.definition: Bloque duro para construir paredes.

definition: To say that someone or something is good.
examples: Can you recommend a good restaurant?
I recommend this book.
The doctor recommended more exercise.

spanish.definition: Decir que alguien o algo es bueno.

definition: A tool for your hair, for painting or for cleaning; to clean or fix something with this tool.
examples: Brush your teeth before bed.
I need a new hair brush.
She brushed her hair in the morning.

spanish.definition: Herramienta para el pelo, para pintar o limpiar; limpiar o arreglar algo con ella.

definition: An idea.
examples: The concept is simple.
It's a hard concept to explain.
He doesn't understand the concept of time.

spanish.definition: Idea.

definition: When something happens later than planned; to make something happen later.
examples: The storm delayed our flight.
Sorry for the delay.
We can't delay the meeting again.

spanish.definition: Cuando algo pasa más tarde de lo planeado; hacer que algo pase más tarde.

definition: A big building with many stores.
examples: Let's go to the mall.
The mall is open until nine.
She works at a shoe store in the mall.

spanish.definition: Edificio grande con muchas tiendas.

definition: The earth where plants grow.
examples: The soil here is very good for corn.
Put the seeds in the soil.
Plants need rich soil.

spanish.definition: Tierra donde crecen las plantas.

definition: Something you say when you aren't happy about something.
examples: I want to make a complaint.
The hotel got many complaints about the noise.
I have no complaints about the food.

spanish.definition: Lo que dices cuando no estás contento con algo.

definition: To travel on water in a boat; a large piece of cloth on a boat.
examples: We sailed across the lake.
The wind filled the sail.
He wants to sail around the world.

spanish.definition: Viajar por agua en un barco; tela grande de un barco.

definition: A person who makes bread and cakes.
examples: The baker gets up at four.
My uncle is a baker.
The baker made a big birthday cake.

spanish.definition: Persona que hace pan y pasteles.

definition: An open round container with a handle.
examples: Fill the bucket with water.
He carried a bucket of sand.
We need a bucket to wash the car.

spanish.definition: Recipiente redondo y abierto con asa.

definition: Words that say what someone or something is like.
examples: Read the description of the product.
The police have a description of the man.
Give me a short description of your house.

spanish.definition: Palabras que dicen cómo es alguien o algo.

definition: A small sign that shows who you are or where you work.
examples: The police officer showed his badge.
You need a badge to enter the building.
I lost my work badge.

spanish.definition: Señal pequeña que muestra quién eres o dónde trabajas.

definition: To find the size or amount of something; an action to solve a problem.
examples: Measure the table before you buy it.
The nurse measured my height.
The city took new safety measures.

spanish.definition: Saber el tamaño o la cantidad de algo; acción para resolver un problema.

definition: The job that something does; to work.
examples: What's the function of this button?
The heart has an important function.
The old elevator still functions.

spanish.definition: Trabajo que hace algo; trabajar.

definition: The strong base under a building; a group that gives money to help people.
examples: The house has a strong foundation.
She works for a children's foundation.
Trust is the foundation of a good marriage.

spanish.definition: Base fuerte bajo un edificio; grupo que da dinero para ayudar.

definition: Hard work; the process of a woman having a baby.
examples: The price includes parts and labor.
She was in labor for ten hours.
Farm labor is very hard.

spanish.definition: Trabajo duro; proceso en el que una mujer tiene un bebé.

definition: Having no place to live.
examples: We gave food to a homeless man.
Many people became homeless after the storm.
She works with homeless families.

spanish.definition: Que no tiene dónde vivir.

definition: Unlucky; bad and making you feel sorry.
examples: It was an unfortunate accident.
He's been very unfortunate this year.
That's an unfortunate mistake.

spanish.definition: Sin suerte; malo y que da pena.

definition: Fighting, especially in a war.
examples: He was injured in combat.
The soldiers are ready for combat.
She's trained in hand-to-hand combat.

spanish.definition: Lucha, sobre todo en una guerra.

definition: A short piece of writing with special lines and sounds.
examples: She wrote a poem for her mother.
We read a love poem in class.
I learned this poem when I was a child.

spanish.definition: Texto corto con líneas y sonidos especiales.

definition: To rub something so it shines; a cream that makes things shine.
examples: He polished his shoes.
She's polishing the table.
I need some nail polish.

spanish.definition: Frotar algo para que brille; crema que hace brillar las cosas.

definition: A machine that travels around the earth in space.
examples: We have satellite TV at home.
The satellite sends pictures of the weather.
The moon is a natural satellite.

spanish.definition: Máquina que viaja alrededor de la Tierra en el espacio.

definition: A shirt that sports players wear.
examples: He wore his team's jersey.
I bought a soccer jersey.
The player gave his jersey to a kid.

spanish.definition: Camisa que usan los jugadores.

definition: A large, strong bird that hunts.
examples: An eagle flew over the mountains.
The bald eagle is a symbol of the U.S.
Eagles have very good eyes.

spanish.definition: Ave grande y fuerte que caza.

definition: Being alone, without other people watching you or knowing about your life.
examples: I need some privacy.
Please respect my privacy.
This app doesn't protect your privacy.

spanish.definition: Estar solo, sin que otros te vean o sepan de tu vida.

definition: Good judgment that comes from knowledge and experience.
examples: My grandmother is full of wisdom.
Wisdom comes with age.
He shared his wisdom with the young players.

spanish.definition: Buen juicio que viene del conocimiento y la experiencia.

definition: To turn something over quickly.
examples: Flip the pancake with a spatula.
She flipped the page.
Let's flip a coin.

spanish.definition: Dar vuelta a algo rápidamente.

definition: A large family group.
examples: Our whole clan came for Christmas.
He's the leader of the clan.
The two clans fought for years.

spanish.definition: Grupo familiar grande.

definition: A plan for how to spend your money.
examples: We're on a tight budget.
What's your budget for the trip?
The school budget is very small.

spanish.definition: Plan de cómo gastar tu dinero.

definition: Lasting only a short time.
examples: It's only a temporary job.
This is a temporary problem.
We found a temporary home.

spanish.definition: Que dura poco tiempo.

definition: Working well and giving the result you want.
examples: This medicine is very effective.
She's an effective teacher.
It's an effective way to learn.

spanish.definition: Que funciona bien y da el resultado que quieres.

definition: A young sheep; its meat.
examples: The lamb followed its mother.
We had lamb for dinner.
The farmer has twenty lambs.

spanish.definition: Oveja joven; su carne.

definition: The story of a book or movie; a secret plan.
examples: The plot of the movie was too hard to follow.
They discovered a plot to kill the king.
He plotted his revenge.

spanish.definition: Historia de un libro o película; plan secreto.

definition: A plan or an idea you suggest; when someone asks another person to marry them.
examples: They accepted my proposal.
She said yes to his marriage proposal.
We sent a proposal to the client.

spanish.definition: Plan o idea que sugieres; cuando alguien le pide matrimonio a otro.

definition: Very strong anger.
examples: He hit the wall in a rage.
She was shaking with rage.
His face was red with rage.

spanish.definition: Enojo muy fuerte.

definition: The main idea or fact that something comes from; a way of doing something regularly.
examples: We meet on a weekly basis.
Trust is the basis of our friendship.
There's no basis for that story.

spanish.definition: Idea o hecho principal del que viene algo; forma regular de hacer algo.

definition: The way someone does something; in the plural, polite ways of behaving.
examples: She spoke in a calm manner.
Good manners are important.
Where are your manners?

spanish.definition: Forma en que alguien hace algo; en plural, formas educadas de comportarse.

definition: To get better after an illness; to get something back.
examples: She's recovering from the flu.
He recovered quickly after the surgery.
The police recovered the stolen car.

spanish.definition: Mejorar después de una enfermedad; volver a tener algo.

definition: To turn something around; to hurt a part of your body by turning it; a surprise in a story.
examples: I twisted my ankle on the stairs.
Twist the top to open the bottle.
The movie has a great twist at the end.

spanish.definition: Dar vuelta a algo; lastimarse al girar una parte del cuerpo; sorpresa en una historia.

definition: To let liquid or gas come out through a hole; a small hole that lets liquid out.
examples: The roof is leaking again.
There's a gas leak in the kitchen.
Water leaked out of the pipe.

spanish.definition: Dejar salir líquido o gas por un hueco; hueco pequeño por donde sale líquido.

definition: One thing in a group or list.
examples: I bought three items at the store.
The first item on the list is milk.
This item is on sale.

spanish.definition: Una cosa de un grupo o una lista.

definition: No longer working because of age.
examples: My father is a retired teacher.
She's been retired for ten years.
Many retired people live here.

spanish.definition: Que ya no trabaja por la edad.

definition: To change or influence someone or something.
examples: The weather affects my mood.
The new law affects everyone.
Smoking affected his health.

spanish.definition: Cambiar o influir en alguien o algo.

definition: Not allowed.
examples: Smoking is forbidden here.
This is forbidden by law.
It's forbidden to take pictures in the museum.

spanish.definition: Que no está permitido.

definition: A small piece of cloth used to cover a hole; a small area; to fix a hole.
examples: She put a patch on his jeans.
There's a patch of ice on the road.
He patched the hole in the tent.

spanish.definition: Trozo de tela para tapar un hueco; área pequeña; arreglar un hueco.

definition: The quality of being funny.
examples: She has a great sense of humor.
I like his dark humor.
The movie has a lot of humor.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser gracioso.

definition: Good at making new things or having new ideas.
examples: My daughter is very creative.
We need a creative solution.
He has a creative job in a design company.

spanish.definition: Bueno para hacer cosas nuevas o tener ideas nuevas.

definition: Several different.
examples: We visited various cities.
She has various reasons for leaving.
The shirt comes in various colors.

spanish.definition: Varios y diferentes.

definition: Finding something for the first time.
examples: It was an important scientific discovery.
The discovery of the body shocked the town.
They made a surprising discovery in the cave.

spanish.definition: Encontrar algo por primera vez.

definition: A man who rides a horse and takes care of cows in the U.S.
examples: He loves old cowboy movies.
The cowboy got on his horse.
My son wants a cowboy hat.

spanish.definition: Hombre que anda a caballo y cuida vacas en EE. UU.

definition: To jump into water with your head first; to go under the water.
examples: She dove into the pool.
He's diving near the coral.
That was a beautiful dive.

spanish.definition: Saltar al agua de cabeza; ir debajo del agua.

definition: A system that finds planes and ships with radio waves.
examples: The plane disappeared from the radar.
The ship has a new radar.
Police use radar to catch fast drivers.

spanish.definition: Sistema que encuentra aviones y barcos con ondas de radio.

definition: A lawyer who tries to prove in court that someone is guilty.
examples: The prosecutor asked the witness many questions.
She's a prosecutor in Miami.
The prosecutor showed the photos to the jury.

spanish.definition: Abogado que trata de probar en un juicio que alguien es culpable.

definition: Very big.
examples: Russia is a vast country.
The vast majority of people agree.
We looked out at the vast ocean.

spanish.definition: Muy grande.

definition: A machine that moves liquid or air; to move liquid or air with a machine.
examples: I need a bike pump.
The heart pumps blood.
He pumped water from the well.

spanish.definition: Máquina que mueve líquido o aire; mover líquido o aire con una máquina.

definition: A card or a person you love on February 14.
examples: Will you be my valentine?
She got a valentine from a secret friend.
The kids made valentines at school.

spanish.definition: Tarjeta o persona que amas el 14 de febrero.

definition: A small, round piece of metal used as money.
examples: He put a coin in the machine.
I found an old coin in the yard.
Do you have any coins for the bus?

spanish.definition: Pieza pequeña y redonda de metal que se usa como dinero.

definition: A soldier who serves on land and sea; related to the sea.
examples: My brother is a Marine.
She studies marine animals.
The marine stood by the door.

spanish.definition: Soldado que sirve en tierra y mar; relacionado con el mar.

definition: A disease; being sick.
examples: She died after a long illness.
He missed work because of an illness.
Mental illness is common.

spanish.definition: Estar enfermo; mal de salud.

definition: A large bag.
examples: He carried a sack of potatoes.
Santa has a big sack of toys.
They filled the sack with rice.

spanish.definition: Bolsa grande.

definition: To need something.
examples: This job requires experience.
The recipe requires two eggs.
All visitors are required to sign in.

spanish.definition: Necesitar algo.

definition: To get something after working hard.
examples: She achieved her goal.
You can achieve anything if you try.
We achieved good results this year.

spanish.definition: Conseguir algo después de trabajar duro.

definition: The home a bird makes for its eggs.
examples: There's a bird's nest in the tree.
The eggs are safe in the nest.
The birds built a nest on our roof.

spanish.definition: Casa que hace un ave para sus huevos.
